aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed 11.1.1, 11.1.2.1, 11.1.2.2, 11.1.3.1 through 11.1.3.4 and 11.1.4 source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_111.json, which opens Clause 11. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 227 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. Only 24 of the 44 scoped base units are newly accounted, because the twenty numbered items R1101, R1102 through R1106 with C1101 through C1106, and R1107 through R1110 with C1107 through C1110 were already inventoried; 119 new facets remain pending. Titles were verified from the source rather than assumed. A precedent was set that will recur throughout Clause 11: sentences of the form it is permissible to branch to an end statement only from within its construct do two things at once, permitting the inward branch and through the word only prohibiting the outward one, and the packet captures both halves rather than losing either. The 11.1.4 p3 processor latitude over specification-expression evaluation order is recorded as a permission with no plan asserting the processor took a particular order. All thirty negative rows of the attribution table were audited rather than sampled, including the R1109 row whose prohibiting words are a grammar production rather than a shall, the seven C1107 rows drawn from a single prohibition list, and the compound-sentence C1101 and 11.1.3.3 p5 rows. Two under-claiming checks were made and accepted: C1104 as source-classification only, because ordinary pointer assignment is conforming through the variable selector alternative, and 11.1.3.4 as zero facets because it is examples. ASSOCIATE observability is genuine and the plans are non-vacuous, with LEN asserted explicitly rather than inferred from character comparison. Two limits are recorded honestly: branch-to-END negatives cannot be implemented until 11.2 registers branch statement syntax and semantics, and the 11.1.3.3 p3 CHANGE TEAM plans are dependency-only until 11.1.5 owns that construct. No block, ASSOCIATE or BLOCK construct execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
